name: 0xarchive
description: Agent-ready 0xArchive market data skill for coding-agent clients across two venues: Hyperliquid and Lighter. Hyperliquid includes HIP-3 builder perps, HIP-4 outcome markets, and Hyperliquid Spot; Lighter has two deployments, mainnet and Robinhood Chain. Covers account positions by Hyperliquid wallet or Lighter account index. REST and WebSocket support are route-specific; Lighter orderbook, trades, open interest, and funding stream live on both deployments, while Lighter candles and L3 are replay-only; HIP-4 trades, L4 events, and settlements are live while HIP-4 L2 and OI use REST or stored replay.
